column1: # superseded.tsv -- THE ONE HOME of a transition this estate has started and
# owes an end to. Read at the point of use by bin/supersession.sh and by
# nothing else, the bin/lib/retired-verbs.tsv shape.
# WHY IT EXISTS (hf7y/realisateur#754). Verbs -- and only verbs -- already had
# this: retired-verbs.tsv records a retirement and check_shrink() in
# bin/cut-verb-build.sh refuses a disappearance no row explains. Nothing else
# in the estate does. Issues, hooks, backends, sensors and crontab rows can be
# replaced and leave the old one running, or be declared and never land, and
# no probe asks. Seven of the second kind were found on 2026-08-29 by a human
# in a chat window and none by any sensor.
# A TRANSITION HAS TWO ENDS, and both halves of the defect are one row here:
#   retired   the ref that must be GONE when this is finished. Still there
#             => RESIDUE: the new thing landed beside the old one.
#   armed     the ref that must be PRESENT when this is finished. Absent
#             => UNARMED: it was built and the switch was never flipped.
# `-` in either column means there is nothing to check on that side.
# Anything other than (retired gone, armed present) reads red.
# REF KINDS, the bin/lib/body-grammar.sh DELIVERS types:

# path:

relative -> the declaring repo's tree; absolute -> this host
#   branch:<name>              present while the declaring repo's remote has it
#   issue:<owner>/<repo>#<n>   present while the issue is OPEN
# An unknown kind is BLIND, never clean.
# DECLARING IS FREE, so a row here is the exception, not the route. The route
# is the PR body every agent already writes: a `retires:` entry in its
# DELIVERS block is harvested by bin/supersession.sh with no file to remember.
#     <!-- DELIVERS -->
#     - retires: path:hooks/old-guard.sh -> path:hooks/new-guard.sh -- why
#     <!-- /DELIVERS -->
# This table is for transitions no PR declared: the ones already outstanding
# when the mechanism landed, and the ones a human notices later.
# Columns:  retired  TAB  armed  TAB  witness  TAB  note
